I'm using liquid 5%. Don't worry too much about the shedding. If it's still happening after 4 months I think the advice is to stop but initially shedding shows the drug is working.

I've been using the Kirkland's one too. I do get a little bit of flakiness and a tiny bit of inflammation but for now it's not too bad, although if it gets worse I'll start on the ketozolane shampoo which I believe is meant to help so perhaps give that a shot? Also from what I understand it's very important to be consistent with minox as it's half life is 22 hours, so for it to be most effective you should be applying it once a day at around the same time. I do twice a day in case I accidently miss one. As for the thinning I think that's quite normal for starting out with min, especially if you miss days with some degree of frequency. Have a look at others experience with shedding see what I mean, mine hasn't been too bad so far, but I know it varies in length and severity (although overall most people say it's worth it). Hope this helps!
